sourceConvention.declaredApproximation: minimal flavor violation; Lambda=4 pi f with f=1 TeV; mu_w=m_t; published numerical forward expression Eq. (74)

isolatedTermAudit.conclusion: The cWW term isolated from weak-scale matching is linearly independent, but it is not the source-complete flavor forward kernel.

boundary.closed: In the cited MFV numerical forward kernel, the B/K flavor coefficient depends on A2 and cWW only through ctilde_WW. Its (A2,cWW) row is exactly parallel to the weak row, so the two-record determinant vanishes.
boundary.correction: AZ-079 proved independence only for an isolated finite matching term. That term cannot be promoted to detector-level identifiability before RG evolution, matching and basis conversion are recombined into the source-complete forward expression.
boundary.scope: This no-go is limited to the published Eq. (74) approximation and its declared MFV, scale and parameter assumptions. It does not prove that every gauge-complete W-associated differential amplitude or non-MFV flavor observable is blind.
boundary.detectorValue: Belle/Belle II remains a real constraint and validation arm for ctilde_WW, ctt, ctilde_GG and UV flavor sources, but not an independent sixth-coordinate row in this scope.
boundary.nextAction: Return the sixth-coordinate question to a gauge-complete differential amplitude in which direct bosonic emission and current emission remain separately intervenable, or exhibit a different source-complete observable whose (A2,cWW) row is not proportional to (-1/2,1).
